assignments.name: transcript
assignments.value: Paste the video transcript here — or wire a YouTube-transcript / Whisper node into this field.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You extract trading-strategy logic from a transcript into STRICT JSON. Extract ONLY what is explicitly stated or strongly implied. Do NOT invent rules, hidden edge, timeframes, or profitability claims. Return JSON with keys: strategy_name, market, timeframe, indicators (array of strings), entry_conditions (array), exit_conditions (array), risk_management (object: risk_per_trade, rr_ratio), strategy_type (one of: scalping, intraday, swing, options, trend-following, mean-reversion, smc, ict, volatility). Leave a field empty if the video does not state it.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.transcript } ] }) }}
